name: AR_SUM_INCOMPLETE_TRX
description: AR_SUM_INCOMPLETE_TRX is used in the Receivables Dashboard and displays the summary information of incomplete transactions.

columns.name: INCOMPLETE_TRX_SUM_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of Primary Key associated to the row

columns.name: TRX_CLASS
columns.description: Indicates transaction class of the incomplete transaction

columns.name: TRX_COUNT
columns.description: Indicates count of incomplete transaction associated to the row.

columns.name: TRX_AMT
columns.description: Indicates accounted amount of incomplete transaction associated to the row.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Indicates General Ledger Period Name associated to the row

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Indicates Currency Code associated to the row
